newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RTZ-CRA does not rule out future gold float.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RTZ-CRA does not rule out future gold float.

text.p: RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd declined on Thursday to rule out the possibility of floating gold assets in the future.
"We may want to revisit that question if we were looking at a very large new gold deposit," executive chairman Robert Wilson said in a televised news conference where he spoke from London.
He said the downside of any float currently was probably greater than the upside because much of the group's nearly two million ounce per year gold production is from copper-gold mines.

"There is in the back of our minds certainly the question of 'well maybe we are not getting full recognition in the way our company is valued in the market in terms of the gold component'," Wilson said.
Wilson added that the group had not changed its position on gold hedging.
'No, we don't regard it by and large as being in the interests of the company to act in forward markets," he said.
"We don't think we need to take that insurance - we would rather self-insure and take the ups and downs as they come," he added.
